concerns.text: Task T004 (checkpointing) lists dependency on T009 (logging_config), but T009 is listed AFTER T004 in the task order. T009 must precede T004 because checkpointing relies on the logging infrastructure defined in T009.
Task T006b (data_model implementation) lists dependency on T006a (skeleton), but T006a is listed AFTER T006b in the task order. T006a must precede T006b.
Task T015 (imputation/exclusion) lists dependency on T015a (schema definition), but T015a is listed AFTER T015 in the task order. Schema definition must precede implementation.
Task T016 (filtering) lists dependency on T015 (imputation) and T016a (schema), but T016a is listed AFTER T016. Schema definition must precede implementation.

Task T017 (metadata extraction) lists dependency on T016 (filtering) and T014 (checksums), but T014 is listed AFTER T017. Checksums must be computed before metadata extraction to ensure only retained datasets are processed.

Task T024a (null data generation) lists dependency on T017 (metadata extraction), but T017 is listed AFTER T024a in the task order. Distribution shape estimation (T017) must complete before simulation (T024a) can use those parameters.

Task T024d (spec alignment) lists dependency on T024c, but T024c is listed AFTER T024d. The spec update task should logically follow the completion of the implementation it corrects, or be placed after T024c.
Task T031a (power simulation) lists dependency on T017, but T017 is listed AFTER T031a. Distribution shape estimation must precede power simulation.
Task T041c (spec alignment for GLMM) lists dependency on T041b, but T041b is listed AFTER T041c. The spec update must follow the implementation it corrects.
Task T043 (sensitivity analysis) lists dependency on T039 and T041a, but T041a is listed AFTER T043. GLMM results must be computed before sensitivity analysis can incorporate them.
Task T044 (visualization) lists dependency on T043, but T043 is listed AFTER T044. Aggregated results must be computed before visualization.
Task T045 (validation) lists dependency on T041a and T041b, but T041a/b are listed AFTER T045. Validation must follow the results it validates.

Task T004b (checkpoint verification) is listed as [US1] but depends on T004 (Foundational). While logically part of US1 testing, it should be grouped with Foundational tasks or clearly marked as a cross-phase dependency to avoid confusion about phase boundaries.

Task T053 (streaming logic) is listed as [US1] but depends on T013. However, T053's description mentions it applies to 'downstream per-row operations' which may conflict with T017's requirement for full dataset loading. The ordering implies T053 runs after T013 but before T017, which is semantically ambiguous.
